offering_description.value: BKV produces natural gas and natural gas liquids for wholesale energy buyers, primarily from wells it operates in Texas and Pennsylvania. It also operates gas gathering and processing infrastructure and provides carbon dioxide capture and underground storage for industrial facilities.

primary_products.value: natural gas; natural gas liquids; condensate

primary_services.value: natural gas gathering, processing and transportation; carbon dioxide capture and underground storage

customer_segment.value: B2B: wholesale gas marketers, utilities, gas producers and processors, and industrial facilities with carbon dioxide emissions

end_markets.value: wholesale natural gas; power generation; petrochemicals; industrial carbon management

revenue_model.value: product sales: natural gas, natural gas liquids and condensate sold to wholesale buyers; service fees: gas gathering, processing and transportation for third parties; other: monetization of federal tax credits for qualifying carbon dioxide sequestration

value_chain_position.value: raw materials: extracts natural gas and liquids from operated wells for wholesale energy buyers; asset operator: runs gathering and processing infrastructure that moves raw gas from wells to downstream buyers; service provider: captures and stores carbon dioxide from gas processing and other industrial facilities
value_chain_position.category: raw materials; asset operator; service provider

geography_served.value: US regional: North Texas Barnett Shale and northeastern Pennsylvania Marcellus Shale

specialization.value: related lines: natural gas production, gas gathering and processing, and carbon capture and storage

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: wholesale contracts with gas marketers, utilities and industrial counterparties; other: gathering systems and interstate pipelines that deliver gas into wholesale markets

regulatory_exposure.value: high: state drilling and operating permits, air and water requirements, and EPA or state underground injection permits

notes: The profile excludes power generation because the current ownership of those assets is uncertain.
